candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student Machine Learning position. Unlocking clinical data so that hospitals can care for patients better is a mission I connect with directly: my most rewarding machine learning project was a medical imaging classifier.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I worked with PyTorch on computer vision and with BERT and GPT-2 in a text clustering project. I also bring industry experience with data pipelines from SAP data & analytics work.

achievements.impact: I built a 4-class retinal OCT scan classifier on a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 in PyTorch, reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
in my thesis team I created training data, evaluated and tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model and compared EasyOCR configurations for scoreboard extraction
in a team project on Reddit text, I compared graph-based and language-model representations (BERT, GPT-2) for clustering with K-Means and HDBSCAN

letter.problems_section: I would support your team by preparing data, evaluating and benchmarking models, and helping integrate them into clinical workflows. I have not yet built LLM, ASR or RAG pipelines, and I would be motivated to learn them in a production setting like yours.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
